sentences.en: I applied to be an attendant at the exposition.
sentences.zh: 我申请成为博览会的工作人员。

sentences.en: Yesterday I took part in the opening of the painting exposition.
sentences.zh: 昨天，我参加了画展的开幕式。

sentences.en: The exposition will be held for six months.
sentences.zh: 这个展览将持续六个月。

senses.zh: 解释，阐述；展览会，博览会；（奏鸣曲等的）呈示部；暴露，揭露

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ex（出）+posit（放）+ion→放出来→展览会
